items.title: Berkshire Stock Peaked the Day Before Warren Buffett Said He'd Step Down as CEO
items.summary: Warren Buffett’s decision to step down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway marks the end of an era on Wall Street.  The conglomerate’s stock has yet to recover from the all-time high it hit on May 2 last year, the day before Buffett announced his plan to step down as CEO.  Since then, Berkshire’s popular Class B shares have slid 5.7%, versus a 34% rise in the S&P 500.
